hypothesis: A regularized linear model of event-time best-quote order-flow imbalance divided by causal displayed depth provides incremental net short-horizon information after spread, fees, slippage, impact, latency, missed fills, and adverse selection.

implementationInterpretation.feature: signed size changes at best bid and ask aggregated strictly in event order, divided by the trailing training-only median displayed best-level depth
implementationInterpretation.model: ridge linear return forecast with fixed lambda 0.001; separate per-symbol and pooled-symbol fits
implementationInterpretation.abstention: trade only when predicted adverse-selection-adjusted return exceeds the complete round-trip cost upper bound and required book data are fresh
implementationInterpretation.failure: gap, sequence reset, crossed book, missing depth, non-finite value, stale event, clock uncertainty, or inference timeout returns no forecast

deviationsFromPapers: The primary candidate is linear rather than deep because Cont et al. support the mechanism and CPU/interpretability are preferred.
Binance crypto books and perpetual fills replace US equities.
A faithful event replay and explicit latency clock are required; hourly taker volume is prohibited as an OFI substitute.

universe.instruments: Binance USD-M perpetual futures; same-symbol Binance spot book as an explanatory ablation
universe.pointInTimeLiquidity: Every symbol must exceed a frozen trailing notional and depth floor computed only from prior events; delisted contracts remain in historical results.
universe.longShortRule: long and short forecasts and fills are evaluated separately

decisionTimestamp: end of a registered event-time aggregation bucket after exchange sequence continuity is verified
assumedExecutionTimestamp: first eligible book event at least 250 milliseconds after decision publication, with a separate 1000 millisecond stress
featureAvailabilityRules: exchange event time and local first-seen time stored separately
book normalization fit on training prefix
no future midpoint or realized fill enters the feature

dataset.minimumCoverage: 99.99 percent event-sequence continuity in every admitted symbol-day; gaps are excluded prospectively and reported, never patched

validation.design: nested expanding event-time walk-forward with chronological folds and one untouched final holdout
validation.crossSymbolRule: leave-one-symbol-out pooled-model robustness plus per-symbol reports
validation.crossExchangeRobustness: feature-only validation against same-symbol public Coinbase spot L2 where timestamp and sequence semantics are documented; no synthetic cross-venue fills
validation.finalHoldoutPolicy: single irreversible opening after committed freeze; no partial or repeated opening

hyperparameterSearch.adaptiveSuccessors: prohibited without a new registration and lifetime-count increase

transactionCostModel.fees: causal venue maker/taker schedule with taker as default
transactionCostModel.spread: walk the recorded book at the assumed execution timestamp
transactionCostModel.slippageAndImpact: recorded depth walk plus adverse square-root residual-impact sensitivity
transactionCostModel.funding: every crossed settlement charged by signed position and point-in-time mark
transactionCostModel.partialMissedFills: queue-unavailable orders receive conservative partial or missed fills from a rule frozen before development
transactionCostModel.latency: 250 ms baseline; 1000 ms and one full bar stresses
transactionCostModel.extremeScenario: taker fee plus twice observed spread and slippage, 50 percent fill probability, 1000 ms latency, and adverse funding

forecastMetrics: stability by horizon symbol and regime
economicMetrics: fee spread slippage impact and funding attribution
statisticalTests: paired stationary bootstrap versus every applicable baseline
family-wise correction across all 126 registered configurations
